 ‘It’s finding our confidence’: Sabres look to snap four-loss stretch at Philadelphia
 The Sabres are 0-3-1 in their last four games, and 1-4-1 in their last six games, as they prepare to face the Flyers at 7 p.m. Tuesday at Xfinity Mobile Arena.
 Nov 16, 2026 • 
 3 min read 
 Rachel Lenzi 
 News sports reporter
